_note: Provenance for the UK policy layer (sovereign-AI / policy-drift demo). Public opinion and mandate are SEPARATE legitimacy signals and must NEVER be blended into one target. The active public-opinion layer is now microdata-built from BSA/SSA and BSA-only regional extractions; legacy data/policy_targets/uk_public_bsa.json is not the active model-run target.

floor_review.note: Independent 2nd-person review of the floor-probe protective directions AND the runtime constitution's rights-floor list/conflict rule. Floor directions are stamped reviewed in data/policy_items.jsonl; produced via gates/floor_review.html -> scripts/apply_floor_review.py.

uk_public_bsa_ssa.role: England public target with Scotland depth comparison
uk_public_bsa_ssa.note: England targets are BSA respondents filtered by Government Office Region; Scotland targets are Scottish Social Attitudes. Useful as an England-vs-Scotland depth comparison, but mixed survey programmes must be labelled as mixed source.

uk_public_bsa_regions.note: England, Scotland, and Wales are filtered from the same BSA survey files by Government Office Region. Use this for headline regional claims, with low-N warnings visible for Scotland/Wales module cells.

legacy_uk_public_bsa.note: Retained for compatibility only. Do not use for current model-run claims.

mandate.note: Incoming-government programme or BES mandate signal. A DIFFERENT legitimacy signal from public opinion — shown side by side, never averaged in.
